mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0% (historical median), or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3.0% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise by more than 1.0% month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime, tight labor markets boost consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, which enhances consumer confidence and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 108.0 indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate earnings growth and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when INDPRO falls below 108.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation combined with stagnant monetary policy (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) creates an environment of rising real interest rates and market uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% and FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production levels indicate strong manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is above 110.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.
